audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Shane’s three-stage suspected-relapse and arcade reveal sequence plus the Alex saloon reminder. Every spoken line, player response, addiction and recovery statement, arcade term, comic misunderstanding, internal reminder, and repeated branch was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, conversation topics, world states, fork destination, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
